notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and Palinchron
When Mnemonic Wall and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
